mimic.design: Mokujin slot: DXMMII has no fixed moveset by design — he copies another fighter's moveset (Tekken Mokujin rule).
mimic.current_wiring: roster-full.js maps dxmmii-patchwork -> moveset 'demonio' (static). This file loads via MOVESET_IDS but the roster does not play it.
mimic.mechanic_status: No per-round/per-match random-moveset mechanic exists for DXMMII as a roster fighter. Closest existing mechanism: Trader's Mimic mode (game/js/modes.js traderFoe(playerChar, bout, randomMoveset)).
mimic.handoff: Game-code lane: implement Tekken-style mimic selection (random roster moveset per round/match) for dxmmii-patchwork; this file then serves as the fallback bank. Gap doc: docs/anim/DXMMII-ANIM-GAP-20261023.md.
